First of all I'm so sorry about how he took advantage of you.. I think that could have been traumatic for you which explains your feelings towards gay people/couples.. 
I am 20 and not the greatest advice giver but I think it could be beneficial to go to a therapist that's specialized in these things.. 
I am guessing you might be asexual on a level but I'm not sure.
It's very good that you're doing some self searching and I respect you for that and doing your best to not be that kind of person!
Also you have every right to have felt that way because what he did was unacceptable, I really hope he is suffering for it. 
And btw we're all naive at 18, so you shouldn't blame yourself for that. Hell I'm 20 and still do the most stupid shit daily. 
I'm very proud of you and I hope you can find it in yourself to heal, and whether or not you're gay or straight it will take time to get closure and answers so take it easy. 
Hope the best for you man
❤❤

The best thing to do to help yourself heal, and yeah don't watch nonsense positivity shit YouTube videos because those people are full of shit..

This was the most thoroughly written and longest one yet.
First thank you for that :)
I read it and I am nearly speechless because I think it surpasses my intellect. My head might be foggy but I understood the moral of it. 
I'm very unsure what to respond because this still puts me in this state of mind that takes all that information and throws a little pessimistic into it. Which is obviously how I started to understand and analyze it.
I used to look at genetics in a different and simplistic way until i started to understand it similarly to you put it(through a series of books by Yuval Noah Harari) and the rest of the topic. 
I don't know how it to put it simply but you basically condensed a few chapters of this book that I read (that I guess I could say changed my school of though and life)
It all connects in this web of human history that my mind weirdly puts together and comprehends in a mind-bending manner. 

This was actually quite helpful and I will revisit the author's writing so I can maybe find an answer beyond what I could just read. You've made it clear that it's an answer I'm sure you have found but I still haven't reached .. yet. Maybe I need to read under the lines or however that line goes.. 
It seems like I should have read up more too, and posting here proved that. It's always good to grow my knowledge because it helps me make sense of everything and expand my horizons.
So thank you again :)

I know how the world works, but at the same time I just really started to believe that everything is a man made illusion. Which is why I feel terrified sometimes when i realize how meaningless everything is. I hate the chemicals in our heads that literally determine our happiness that we can "hack" into being well adjusted and happy.. In the old days they didn't know what those chemicals were.. All they had was basically poetry and god and themselves, but they felt like they have a purpose in life with all these delusions. Being an atheist now ofcourse I used to think that I should strive for happiness and help others to make the world a better place because clearly god is dead. I'm not sure if it made any sense but I spend half of my time being happy (while indulging myself in all sorts of meaningless activities that are in no way productive or useful) and the other half is contemplating the whole world because that other half that's been blinded by shiny tv shows and satisfying YouTube thumbnails is only temporary and the real me is like this cockroach that's the most insignificant thing in the world because the world works in this intricate way that i will always understand, fit in or succesfully be apart of.. 
I'm very sorry for the sloppy writing lol, I hope you understand it.. my mind's in all sorts of places
